categories.main_business_segments: Doosan Robotics Inc. primarily operates in the manufacturing and solution provision of industrial collaborative robots (cobots). The company focuses on a single business segment centered on collaborative robot arms and related robotic solutions, including service robots like coffee modules. It also explores new business areas such as unmanned robotic cafes and robotics platform services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include torque sensor-based joint control, gravity compensation mechanisms, and advanced robot control algorithms developed by a team of PhD and master-level researchers. Production involves both in-house manufacturing at its Suwon plant and outsourced production, with plans to expand automated and AMR (Autonomous Mobile Robot) integrated production facilities domestically and overseas. The company also develops proprietary software platforms like Dart-Suite for robot operation and ecosystem integration.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Doosan Robotics serves global machining solution providers, robot solution companies, and various industrial sectors primarily in the US, Europe, and Korea. Its customers include system integrators and dealers who supply end-users in manufacturing and service industries such as F&B automation. The company targets both B2B industrial automation markets and emerging service robot markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with a strong presence in North America, Europe, and South Korea. It has established a US subsidiary to strengthen sales and marketing in the Americas and plans to open a European branch. Sales channels include domestic and international dealers and direct sales, with a global network exceeding 100 sales channels.
categories.supply_chain_position: Doosan Robotics operates primarily in the midstream segment of the robotics supply chain, focusing on design, manufacturing, and sales of collaborative robot arms and integrated robotic solutions. It outsources non-core components while maintaining control over core technologies and assembly. The company also supports system integrators downstream by providing robotic products and software platforms.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes R&D to enhance collaborative robot safety, precision, and payload capabilities, including developing new models with higher payloads and specialized applications like F&B. It invests heavily in software platform development (Dart-Suite) to enable ecosystem expansion and recurring revenue through software subscriptions. Future R&D directions include AI vision integration, mobile manipulators (MoMa), and expansion into B2C robotics markets.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of collaborative robot arms and related robotic modules. The company also earns from selling robotic solutions like coffee modules and palletizing systems. It plans to diversify revenue streams by expanding software platform sales, subscription-based services (RaaS), and after-sales services including refurbishment and parts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Doosan Robotics is positioned as a global top 4 player in the collaborative robot market, competing with Universal Robots (market leader), FANUC, Techman Robot, ABB, and KUKA. It differentiates itself through a broader product lineup, competitive pricing (approximately 90% of Universal Robots’ price), and superior safety certifications (PL e, Cat 4). The company leverages its parent group’s industrial expertise and expanding global sales network to strengthen market presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, Doosan Robotics achieved approximately 53 billion KRW in revenue, reflecting an 18% year-over-year growth. The company has rapidly expanded its capital base through multiple equity issuances, culminating in a public listing in October 2023. Total assets surged to 456 billion KRW with a low debt ratio of 4%, indicating strong financial health. Despite operating losses due to R&D and market expansion investments, the company maintains a robust growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Doosan Robotics offers highly safe, precise, and versatile collaborative robots with a wide payload range (5kg to 25kg), supported by advanced torque sensors and gravity compensation technology. Its products require no safety fences, enabling flexible deployment alongside human workers. The company’s intuitive direct-teaching operation and competitive pricing lower adoption barriers. Additionally, its integrated robotic solutions and software platform ecosystem provide customers with turnkey automation capabilities and scalable service models.
